notes.title: Can I see the menu?
notes.content:
[p]Hi![/p][p]
You have already seen examples from all the beautiful levels we have prepared for you, you have listened to some of our soundtrack, you have had a glimpse into the bonus comics you can read. It may seem we have it all done - so what is holding us from releasing right now? We need some more time to put it all together. Right now, we are finishing the game menu so it all works without problems, but after that (and some testing) we should be ready to release soon![/p][p]And how does the menu look right now?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973996/768c326e86eca35fc825fb8b24ecaa626e406f2d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973996/f200e046bf08ee3acd00495d48cab0b5ab9c2a36.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="1oHxCME_JGM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Smooth as spaghetti
notes.content:
[p]Hello![/p][p]
Our latest update in finishing the game is changing the, as we call them, “spaghetti animations”. The narrative of our game is accompanied by these abstract animations. They represent the magical-mechanical processes occurring within the circuits of our main character, the Guardian, as she struggles to regain the Light. At first, these animations were rendered in game in real time. Unfortunately, this proved to be tougher on the computation and the animations have occasionally encountered errors. That is why we have decided to create a video animation to make sure everything will be running without problems.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="R3375ufRf4A;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="V6zK-vKr3q4;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Voices and Vibes
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]
In [i]Elfscape: Ancestors[/i], the gameplay is accompanied by narration from the main character, the Guardian. Her monologues are part of the story - she comments on your progress with helpful tips and shares her thoughts about the in-game events.[/p][p]The Guardian is voiced by the talented [b]Eli Nightingale ([/b][url="https://x.com/EliNightVA"]https://x.com/EliNightVA[/url]) , whose performance helps bring the character to life. She can be proud, she can be bossy, but she’s also enthusiastic and passionate - you’ll love her![/p][p][b]🔊Sound on! 🔊[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="3b14GCv0oQE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

What do you think? We’re excited to hear your impressions :)[/p]

notes.content:
Hi!

First of all, we want to wish you a happy 2025 and thank you for following our story through the developer diaries. You are the best! :)

To start the new year on a light funny note, look at this bug - it’s an unfortunate rotating of the dog god statue:

[previewyoutube=36TuS9yrYtY;full][/previewyoutube]

This is what it was originally supposed to work like… :D

[previewyoutube=ZpoSZUjnPrI;full][/previewyoutube]

And good news, this is the last time we wish you a new year through our developer’s diary! This year, Elfscape: Ancestors will be finally finished and published.

notes.title: Tune-Tastic Tracks
notes.content:
Our soundtrack for Elfscape: Ancestors represents different music styles, from gentle emotional piano to energetic electronic beats. We’ll show you two tracks from the soundtrack album, just to get a taste. The game music is adaptive and responds to the gameplay. It is created in FL Studio, and implemented into the game with the use of middleware Fmod.

Sound on! :)

This emotional track is featured at the beginning of the game, in the menu.

[previewyoutube=FmDI-28hp7E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


The battle track can be heard during the boss encounters at the end of the game.

[previewyoutube=xSPwd3jydHA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Keys or buttons
notes.content:
Today we’ll take a look at the current work in progress of our programmer - controls mapping. The preferred and recommended way to play Elfscape: Ancestors is using your gamepad controller, as it will provide you with the best and most balanced experience. However for those of you that don’t have or don’t like gamepads, don’t worry! Of course we are adding the option to use your keyboard, and to remap the game controls as you see fit. Let´s look at some screenshots of hard programmer work. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973996/b868d793220f9e1ae557a7dc6b3ea57b7af91ac1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973996/096d3f0d785d75a66571b71dcb6bc16f3d0fa576.png[/img]

notes.title: Level embellishments
notes.content:
Welcome back to our dev diary series on level design. Today, we’re discussing the creation of immersive environments. As shown in the images below, lighting is just the beginning. We’re also adding various decorations to make each level unique.

From plants and windows to runes and artifacts, these embellishments contribute to the overall scene. Additional lights are also being added to enhance the ambiance. These elements not only improve the appearance of the levels but also enrich the gaming experience.

notes.content:

Rendering in-game lights can be demanding on the computer, so we are compromising between the volume of lights and computer performance. We aim to optimize the lighting in order to spare resources, with the use of the Lights 2D package from Unity.

notes.title: (#74 Dev Diary)
notes.content:
Hello!

Today, allow us to introduce you to two of our main characters: the Guardian and the High Priest. When these two characters first meet, they find themselves unable to understand each other—they don’t speak the same language. However, their sprites change their looks based on their mood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973996/11844751ab7aeb27dad43c70a0bf4ba4ce796425.png[/img]

The player, too, faces a language barrier with the priest, who communicates in a unique language crafted specifically for our game. However, fear not! Despite the linguistic challenge, you can still follow the flow of their conversation by paying attention to the facial expressions of our characters.
